en.summary: This commit fixes operand-collector assignment so ordered LSU traffic is forced onto one dedicated collector instead of whichever collector happens to be ready.
why_it_counts: The patch changes active RTL scheduling logic in a core operand-collection module.
The new EX_LSU branch is explicitly about preserving load/store ordering.
The change is localized and directly reversible for fault injection.
evidence: The patch adds an EX_LSU case that clears all collectors except collector 1.
The added comment states that LD/ST instructions should be ordered via the same collector.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a design with multiple operand collectors or issue queues feeding one LSU, memory operations that are expected to preserve per-warp program order must be funneled through one stable collector. If they are allowed to enter any ready collector, different collectors can advance independently and later loads/stores can bypass earlier ones.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The DUT has more than one operand collector or equivalent pre-LSU issue queue, and two or more LSU operations from the same ordered stream can be in flight.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the rule that pins LSU requests to one dedicated collector, so ordered memory operations may use any currently ready collector.
portability_notes: Map 'collector' to any pre-execution structure that can independently queue or advance memory instructions.
The exact collector index is not important; the bug is the loss of single-queue serialization.
If the target DUT has only one such queue, this bug is not applicable.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that masks or selects eligible operand collectors for LSU or memory instructions.
Delete the LSU-specific mask, or replace it with the generic 'all ready collectors are eligible' behavior.
Keep the rest of the scoreboard and collector logic unchanged so only the ordering constraint is removed.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ready_opcs collector-selection logic before scoreboard fan-out
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds an EX_LSU branch that masks ready_opcs down to collector 1, alongside the existing WCTL pinning rule.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the combinational ready_opcs logic, remove the EX_LSU condition that clears all collectors except index 1.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Loads and stores from the same warp can be observed or serviced out of order, which can corrupt memory-order assumptions or outstanding-request bookkeeping.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, only WCTL traffic had dedicated collector pinning.
After the fix, EX_LSU gets its own dedicated collector mask.
The source comment explicitly ties the change to LD/ST ordering.
notes: Leave the WCTL-specific collector rule unchanged if the goal is to isolate only the LSU regression.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了操作数 collector 分配逻辑，使需要保持顺序的 LSU 流量固定进入一个专用 collector，而不是落到任何恰好 ready 的 collector。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了核心操作数收集模块中的有效 RTL 调度逻辑。
新增的 EX_LSU 分支明确是为了保持 load/store 顺序。
该修改局部、清晰，便于做反向故障注入。
evidence: 补丁新增了 EX_LSU 情况，并将除 collector 1 之外的 collector 全部清零。
新增注释明确写明 LD/ST 指令应通过同一个 collector 保持顺序。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在具有多个操作数 collector 或多个发射队列、但最终汇入同一个 LSU 的设计里，要求保持每个 warp 程序顺序的内存操作必须被送入一个稳定的 collector。如果允许它们进入任何 ready 的 collector，不同 collector 会独立推进，后续 load/store 就可能绕过更早的操作。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 有序 LSU 操作的 collector 分配
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: DUT 具有多个操作数 collector 或等价的 LSU 前级发射队列，并且同一有序流中可以同时存在两个及以上 LSU 操作。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 移除把 LSU 请求固定到单一 collector 的规则，使这些有序内存操作可以使用任意当前 ready 的 collector。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除有序类别的 collector 固定规则
portability_notes: 可将这里的 collector 映射到任何会独立排队或独立推进内存指令的前级结构。
具体是 collector 0 还是 1 并不重要，关键在于失去了单队列串行化。
如果目标 DUT 只有一个此类队列，则该故障不适用。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到针对 LSU 或内存指令限制可选 collector 的逻辑。
删除 LSU 专用屏蔽条件，或改回“所有 ready collector 都可用”的通用行为。
保持其余 scoreboard 和 collector 逻辑不变，只去掉这一顺序约束。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: scoreboard 分发前的 ready_opcs collector 选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在原有 WCTL 固定规则之外，新增了 EX_LSU 分支，把 ready_opcs 屏蔽到 collector 1。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 ready_opcs 的组合逻辑中，删除 EX_LSU 条件以及“只保留 index 1”的清零操作。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 同一 warp 的 load/store 可能乱序发出或被服务，破坏内存顺序假设，或者扰乱未完成请求的记账。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前只有 WCTL 流量有专用 collector 固定规则。
修复后 EX_LSU 也获得了专用 collector 屏蔽。
源码注释明确把该修改与 LD/ST 顺序绑定。
notes: 若只想复现 LSU 回归，可保留 WCTL 的 collector 固定规则不变。
